posts.title: macOS Liquid Glass VS Code Theme: Cursed or Blursed?
posts.description: It’s macOS Golden Gate season! Anyway, in case you were ever wondering what the world’s first Liquid Glass theme for VS Code looked like (you probably weren’t), here you go. I can’t quite see it, is that a walkthrough?! An agentic aesthetic! The install process is pretty cursed, but if you’re really wanting it that badly, you can have it! The theme currently exists as an open PR over at @illixion/

posts.title: I Found Two Shopify Plugin Zero-Days In A Bathtub
